subject: Shit To Do in NYC (Sep 14): Erol Alkan, Berghain in Ridgewood, Steuben Parade
opener: Last real stretch of outdoor season, and the calendar cooperated: a proper Thursday DJ booking in the best-sounding small room in Brooklyn, a Berghain resident in Ridgewood on Saturday, and the German-American parade rolling up Fifth on Saturday morning. Here's the plan. Send two texts and you're the guy who had it handled.

picks.headline: Erol Alkan in the Public Records Sound Room
picks.title: Erol Alkan, Justin Strauss
picks.why: Your Thursday slot, fifteen minutes from home, in a sub-200 room built for exactly this. Alkan plays a long club set, not a 60-minute name-drop. This is the register you keep saying you want: no marketing budget, no line, you can talk to the bartender between records.
picks.heads_up: Doors 10:30pm, so it's a late one. Tickets through Dice on the venue calendar and the Sound Room is small enough that it goes.
picks.invite_text: Erol Alkan is playing the small room at Public Records Thursday night, doors 10:30. I'm grabbing tickets, you in?

verification.note: Dice link would not load, but the Public Records official calendar (publicrecords.nyc) lists 'Thu 9.17, Club, 10:30 pm, Sound Room — Erol Alkan, Justin Strauss' at 233 Butler St (Gowanus); price not shown on the venue calendar.

picks.headline: Freddy K and a Ridgewood day-into-night
picks.title: DAY+NIGHT: D.Dan, Freddy K, Massimiliano Pagliara, Elle Dee, Ron Like Hell
picks.when: Sat Sep 19, 3pm outdoors in the Ruins, club rooms from 10pm, runs to 7am
picks.why: You've been asking for the Berlin room. Freddy K is an actual Berghain resident and Basement is the closest New York gets. The smart move is the 3pm outdoor half in the Ruins with the guys and out before it becomes a 4am problem, though it does run to 7am if nobody has a babysitter deadline.
picks.heads_up: Doors 3pm outdoors, club rooms from 10pm, scheduled through 7am. Tickets on RA. Go early and leave early unless you want to lose Sunday.
picks.invite_text: Saturday afternoon: Berghain resident playing the outdoor yard at Basement in Ridgewood from 3pm. Day drinking to techno, home at a reasonable hour.

verification.note: RA event 2502904 states Sat, Sep 19, 2026, 15:00–07:00 at BASEMENT with D.Dan/Elle Dee/Mos in The Ruins from 3PM and Freddy K/Ron Like Hell/cotton plus Massimiliano Pagliara in STUDIO from 10PM; RA gives the address as 52-19 Flushing Ave (listed as Maspeth rather than Ridgewood), no price shown.

picks.headline: Company XIV's Petite Rouge in Bushwick
picks.title: Petite Rouge
picks.when: Thu Sep 17 to Sat Oct 31, evening performances; showtimes vary by night, pick yours on the box office calendar
picks.why: Their Halloween show was one of your favorite nights in the city, and this is the current mainstage from the same house. Baroque burlesque, aerial work, live singing, Little Red Riding Hood done filthy. Small room, performers pour your drink, and it's the date night that doesn't need explaining to her.
picks.heads_up: Showtimes vary by night, pick yours on the box office calendar. Book now; once the Halloween weeks open up, the good seats and the champagne couches go first. Could not re-check the listing page this morning. Confirm the date on the link before you buy.
picks.invite_text: Got a babysitter idea: Company XIV's new show in Bushwick, Friday or Saturday. Same people who did the Halloween one you loved.

verification.note: The Company XIV show page loads and says Petite Rouge is 'extended through Halloween' at Théâtre XIV, but neither it nor the /tickets/ box-office page states a Thursday Sep 17 performance time or price (the calendar is a script-driven widget), so the specific showtime is unconfirmed.

picks.headline: Dancehall vs Soca closing party at Littlefield
picks.title: DANCEHALL vs SOCA – Summer Closing Party
picks.when: Fri Sep 18 to Sat Sep 19, 11pm to 4am
picks.why: Your last six months of listening is Popcaan, Shenseea, Sean Paul and everything around them. This is that scene in a Gowanus room you can walk out of at 1am instead of trekking back from a warehouse. Summer closing party, so the crowd treats it like the last one.
picks.heads_up: 21+, 11pm to 4am. Late start, so eat first and don't plan on being useful Saturday morning.
picks.invite_text: Dancehall and soca party at Littlefield Friday night, 11pm. Summer closing thing. Come out for a couple hours.

verification.note: Littlefield's own site lists 'DANCEHALL vs SOCA – SUMMER CLOSING PARTY IN BROOKLYN', September 18, 2026, 11:00 pm – September 19, 2026, 4:00 am, 21+, at littlefield; no price shown on the listing.

picks.headline: Stein-holding contest at Radegast, Saturday
picks.title: Oktoberfest at Radegast Hall
picks.when: Sat Sep 19 to Sat Oct 3, 3pm brass band, 4pm women's mug holding, 5pm men's mug holding, 6pm ceremonial keg tapping, 9pm DJ dance party
picks.price: free entry, pay for beer; reservations by email
picks.why: Real Oktoberfest programming, not a bar chain doing dirndl night: brass band at 3, men's Masskrugstemmen at 5, ceremonial keg tapping at 6, DJ after 9. You can actually enter the stein-holding, which is the participating-not-watching thing you like. Ten minutes from Kings Combat.
picks.heads_up: Free entry, you pay for beer. Table reservations are limited and handled by email, so write them this week or plan to stand.
picks.invite_text: Saturday afternoon at Radegast for Oktoberfest. Brass band at 3, men's stein-holding contest at 5. I'm entering, you're my second.

verification.note: Radegast Hall's Oktoberfest page lists Saturday Sept 19 (also 26 and Oct 3): 3 PM brass band, 4 PM women's mug holding, 5 PM men's, 6 PM keg tapping, 9 PM DJ party; it states no cover and says reservations are only taken for parties of 25+ via its Toast booking link, not email.

picks.headline: Shabbat sauna and ice bath at Othership
picks.title: Shabbat Social Schvitz
picks.why: Two of your lanes in one room: bathhouse day and Jewish programming, in Williamsburg where you already train. Guided sauna rounds, private ice baths, then hang in the commons. Friday 9pm to 11:30 is a dad-sized night out, not a weekend-destroying one.
picks.heads_up: Ticket price wasn't confirmed on their page, so check before you promise anyone. Runs 9 to 11:30pm, and these sessions cap at the sauna's capacity.
picks.invite_text: Friday night sauna and cold plunge session at Othership in Williamsburg, 9 to 11:30. Shabbat reset thing. Want to come?

verification.note: Othership's event page states Shabbat Social Schvitz at Othership Williamsburg, Friday, Sep 18, 9:00 PM – 11:30 PM EDT; no price is listed on the page (reservation goes through their schedule).

picks.headline: Catching Fire, rebuilt from memory, drunk
picks.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire Entirely From Memory
picks.when: Thu Sep 17, doors 7:30pm, show 8pm, ends about 10pm
picks.why: Comedians reconstructing a Hunger Games sequel with no script, no rehearsal and no sobriety. Back-room format, crowd in on the joke, exactly the register of that Midtown apartment show. And it's done by 10 in Gowanus, which means you can walk it straight into the Erol Alkan set.
picks.heads_up: 21+, doors 7:30, show 8, out around 10. Same night and neighborhood as the Public Records booking, so it stacks if you want a full Thursday.
picks.invite_text: Thursday: comedians reenacting Catching Fire from memory at Littlefield, 8pm. Then the DJ thing at Public Records after if we're feeling it.

verification.note: Littlefield's site lists 'The Hunger Games: Catching Fire Entirely From Memory', September 17, 2026, 8:00 pm–10:00 pm, Doors 7:30 pm, 21+; no price shown.

radar.headline: Sasha and John Digweed, open to close
radar.title: Sasha & John Digweed: All Night Long
radar.when: Fri Sep 25, doors 11pm, open-to-close set until close
radar.why: These two invented the long-form progressive house set, which is the whole lineage running from Prydz to Tinlicker to your deadmau5 problem. No support, one arc, all night in the Knockdown main hall. If you buy one ticket off this email, buy this one.
radar.book_by: Fri Sep 25. Dice tiers start around $43 and climb as they sell, so buy now not later.

verification.note: Dice page would not load; doNYC's event page for Sasha & John Digweed: All Night Long confirms Fri Sep 25, 2026, 11:00PM at Knockdown Center, 21+, and lists the current ticket at $38.17 rather than $43.

radar.headline: Knicks opening night, banner raising, LeBron
radar.title: Knicks vs Philadelphia 76ers — Opening Night and banner raising
radar.when: Tue Oct 20, 7pm ET start; banner raising before tipoff
radar.why: You watched the whole playoff run from bars. This is the payoff, in the building, with the banner going up and LeBron in a Philly jersey. It's a Tuesday, which is the only reason it isn't a pick.
radar.heads_up: Be in your seat by 7pm: the banner raising happens before tipoff, not 7:30.
radar.book_by: Tickets for Oct 20 are moving now and opening-night prices only go one direction.

verification.note: Ticketmaster was not fetched; ABC7's schedule story confirms the Oct 20 opener vs the 76ers at Madison Square Garden with the ring/banner ceremony, and NBC Philadelphia's schedule report states the MSG broadcast and banner raising begin at 7 p.m. ET (OKC-San Antonio follows at 9:30).

radar.headline: Timmy Regisford plays Shelter, 3pm Sunday
radar.title: Shelter: Timmy Regisford Open to Close
radar.why: A New York institution most people only know by reputation, one man playing open to close in a 200-cap room on a Sunday afternoon. You're home by dinner. This is the you-had-to-know-about-it register in its purest form.
radar.book_by: Sun Sep 27, tickets via Dice on the venue calendar. Sound Room capacity means it goes quietly.

verification.note: Dice link blocked; the Public Records calendar lists 'Sun 9.27, Club, 3:00 pm, Sound Room — Shelter: Timmy Regisford Open To Close'; no price shown.

radar.headline: Jan Blomqvist live at Knockdown Center
radar.title: Jan Blomqvist, Parallelle, Kanykei
radar.why: Berlin, melodic house, performed live with vocals rather than DJed. Sits directly between your Kalkbrenner and Tinlicker listening. He sells out mid-size rooms here.
radar.book_by: Oct 16. Buy early, this one sells out.

verification.note: Dice link blocked; doNYC's Knockdown Center calendar lists 'Jan Blomqvist, Parallelle, Kanykei' on Friday Oct 16, 2026 at 10:00PM at Knockdown Center (52-19 Flushing Ave); no price captured.

radar.headline: Art Book Fair opening night at MoMA PS1
radar.title: Printed Matter's 2026 NY Art Book Fair (opening night + fair)
radar.when: Thu Sep 24 to Sun Sep 27, opening night Thursday 7pm to 10pm; fair Friday through Sunday, daytime
radar.address: 22-25 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY 11101
radar.why: Opening night at PS1 is the zine-and-design version of that photo studio party you loved: 250 exhibitors, people who actually make things, drinks in hand, on a Thursday. The Saturday daytime version works with the stroller if the group chat flakes.
radar.heads_up: Opening night is a $60 ticket; the Friday-to-Sunday fair days are $10 each.
radar.book_by: Opening night is Thu Sep 24, 7 to 10pm. Check the fair site for entry details before you go.

verification.note: The fair's own Visit page confirms MoMA PS1, Thursday Sep 24 opening night 7–10 PM ($60, includes weekend re-entry), Fri 12–7, Sat 10–7, Sun 12–6 at $10 each, advance tickets encouraged.

anytime.headline: Barbès, the back room in Park Slope
anytime.title: Barbès
anytime.when: Mon to Fri 5pm to 2am, Sat and Sun 2pm to 3am; most shows 7pm, 8pm and 10pm
anytime.price: door charge or donation, collected at the door or paid online; varies by show
anytime.why: Sixty people, no stage barrier, live music every single night for twenty-plus years: klezmer, Balkan brass, Peruvian psych, West African. The monthly calendar is a PDF on their site, which tells you everything about how they operate. Bookmark it and you always have a Thursday.

verification.note: Barbès' own events page loads and confirms the bar/venue in Park Slope, hours Mon–Fri 5pm–2am and Sat–Sun 2pm–3am, and states shows are donation-based or have a set door price payable online or at the door; the nightly calendar is a downloadable PDF.

anytime.headline: Gottscheer Hall, Ridgewood's German club hall
anytime.title: Gottscheer Hall
anytime.price: beer-hall prices; Oktoberfest events ticketed separately, price not confirmed
anytime.why: A 1924 Gottschee community hall with a ballroom, grumpy bartenders and an annual Oktoberfest with the Hofbräu stein-holding competition. The anti-Bierhaus. Call ahead for the Oktoberfest date, it wasn't posted.

verification.note: The Mato venue page confirms Gottscheer Hall, 657 Fairview Ave, Ridgewood, as a bar/grill and hall with live music, karaoke and Volksfest programming, but states 'No upcoming events scheduled'; its Annual Oktoberfest & Steinholding ($20) is listed under past events on Sep 10, 2026.

anytime.headline: The Lineup: sous chefs get one night
anytime.title: The Lineup Dinner (sous chef pop-up series, Season 7)
anytime.price: $50 and up per OpenTable (past seasons ran about $165 a seat)
anytime.why: One-night-only dinners where sous chefs from serious kitchens cook their own five courses with wine pairings, in the Navy Yard. The chef-collab format you asked for, twenty minutes from home. Season 7 dates and price weren't confirmed, so check OpenTable before you promise anyone a table.
anytime.heads_up: The listing now puts The Lineup at 639 Lorimer St in Williamsburg, not Food52 in the Navy Yard, and it can't be booked through OpenTable — buy through thelineupdinner.com.

verification.note: The OpenTable profile loads but is for Season 8 with an address of 639 Lorimer St, Williamsburg, says 'Not available on OpenTable', and the only dinner dates it names (Oct 23, Nov 6, Nov 20 with chefs Stultz, Lynfield, Varley) are from the prior season; the operator's own site lists no upcoming dates, so no 2026 dinner date could be verified.

family.headline: Steuben Parade up Fifth Avenue, Saturday noon
family.title: 69th German-American Steuben Parade
family.when: Sat Sep 19, steps off at noon, runs about three hours
family.price: free to watch on the street; grandstand seats sold separately by the committee
family.why: The one day a year the actual German-American community in New York is out in numbers: Trachten, Bavarian marching bands, floats, clubs from across the country. The kid gets brass bands and drums from the stroller, you get the real thing instead of a beer tent. Steps off at noon, done in about three hours.
family.invite_text: Saturday: the German parade goes up Fifth at noon, marching bands and Trachten and the whole thing. Easy stroller morning and we're home for the nap.

verification.note: The parade committee's Future Parade Dates page states Saturday, September 19, 2026, with 9 am Mass at St. Patrick's and the parade kicking off on Fifth Avenue at 12 noon; it says nothing about grandstand pricing (separate Tickets page).
